## Synopsis

Replays the dead-letter lane of the named sink (sinks[].name in strazad config):
each parked event is POSTed again and leaves the lane when the receiver accepts it
(a 409 counts: the receiver already holds it). The replay stops at the first
refusal and reports it; nothing is re-parked or dropped. Bounded per call
(--limit, default 1000): run it again while events remain.

```
strazactl sinks replay <name> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --limit int   max events to replay in this call (server default 1000)
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
